title: Every field an outsider wrote in one row of the store
description: The body of an ingestion.text log record: the outsider-written fields of one store row, as JSON. It carries the same ingestion.record.kind, ingestion.record.id and ingestion.record.version attributes as the ingestion.record holding the rest of that row, so a reader granted both joins them on those three. A row with no outsider-written field ships no ingestion.text. A reader that must never meet outsider text is granted ingestion.record alone.

title.description: The artifact's title, as its source gave it.

external_key.description: The connector's own key for the artifact, such as a canonical URL or a post's id.

path.description: Where the file lives under its root.

outputs.title: outputs
outputs.description: A scan holds each finding's span. A model stage holds its answer. A failed output holds its error. A parse's text is in parse_units.

text.description: Null. A parse's text is its parse_units rows joined by a blank line.

units.description: Null. A parse's units are rows of parse_units.

spans.description: Each finding's matched text: item i is the span of finding i in the ingestion.record of the same kind, id and version.

answer.description: A model stage's structured answer, whole, as the stage's schema holds it. The quality gate answers genre, domains, themes and a one-line idea beside the record's fields. A model read answers a summary, a suggestion sentence, or both.

error.description: Why the output failed, such as an extractor's stderr or the run's error.

parse_units.title: parse_units
parse_units.description: One unit of a parse, such as a thread's post or comment or a book's page. A parse's whole text is its units' text in the order of n, joined by a blank line.

label.description: The unit's own heading, such as a comment's author or a chapter's title.

last_error.description: Why the connector's newest run failed, such as a folder scan's error naming the files it could not land.
